title: Rook Behind Bishop
setup: Black's king is still on e8 opposite your rook on e1, and only your own bishop keeps the file closed.
hint: Your bishop is the one thing holding the e-file shut. Where can it go and pay for itself on the way?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxc7+}} takes the queen and opens the rook's check down the e-file at the same moment. The rook on c8 does defend c7, but Black must answer the check first and can only win the bishop back afterward: a queen for a bishop.
